topic: Antenna signal obstruction and deployment update
summary_markdown:
The discussion began with a query regarding potential signal interference from an awning over an antenna in Germany, specifically whether the material or placement of the awning could partially obstruct the signal. It was noted that the awning is metal but the antenna protrudes from underneath it.

Separately, one participant confirmed deploying functionality to use object height for speed calculation (for 2D lidars) and requested a review of its availability.
action_items: [p2] needs someone to check the availability/review of using object height for speed calculation.
